Neither generation recovery after registration/Dispose/factory error, callback reentrancy/concurrent replacement, nor draining arbitrary agent tasks is established by this bounded local getter contract. The concrete constructor/callback stages and System.Lazy/CancellationTokenRegistration scheduling/lifetime behavior remain separate operative obligations.
